Hi team,

Quick technical notes to help with the kickoff:

SSO/SAML:
- ACS URL: https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs (POST)
- Entity ID / Issuer: https://redwood.ai/saml/metadata
- SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows supported; we prefer SP-initiated for provisioning flows.
- NameID: email is standard. We can map name/email/employeeNumber on assertion.
- Attribute examples we accept: email, givenName, familyName, employeeNumber, department, groups (array).
- Signing: RSA-SHA256 signed assertions; metadata XML preferred.

SCIM provisioning (SCIM 2.0):
- Endpoints: POST /scim/v2/Users, PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}, /Groups endpoints supported.
- Rate limits: default 60 req/min for production; can be increased for Dedicated customers — specify expected provisioning burst counts.
- Schema: we support standard user fields plus custom extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:redwood:2.0:User for role/team attributes. Include a sample user JSON if you have it.
- Group sync: preferred approach — groups map to Redwood teams; group membership changes are applied as incremental PATCH operations. If you want authoritative group sync (overwrite), let us know.

Service accounts & rotation:
- We recommend a service account naming convention: svc-finsecure-<purpose> (e.g., svc-finsecure-provisioner).
- Auth: JWT signed with customer-managed KMS (preferred) or long-lived API key for short trials.
- Least privilege: create role scopes for provisioning vs. admin vs. read-only audit access.
- Rotation: keys rotated every 90 days; we can help automate via our KMS integrations.

Org policies & audit logs:
- By default, org-level policies set onboarding role to "team-admin" only during canary; full admin assignment requires request + POA.
- Audit logs: token-level audit, retention 90 days by default; longer retention is an add-on. We can provide export of logs for SOC review.

I attached a short internal runbook link (private) and a template SCIM user example to the shared doc referenced by Evelyn. I'll be on the kickoff Thursday.

- Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
